simpleJp: 【任意・2周目】1周目のエンディング後、クリアデータからニューゲーム＋を開始する
jpGuide2: 2周目以降にアカデメイアで黙示録を調べると戦えます。
enGuide: Optional separate second playthrough begins ONLY after finishing the first-run ending in the previous section. Start New Game Plus from clear data; this is NOT a requirement for the preceding all-14-Followers Rank 8 / first-run quest target. Source: GameWith's NG+ boss guide and Game8 2nd-run overview.

simpleJp: 【任意・2周目】アカデメイアへ戻れるようになるまで物語を進める
enGuide: In NG+, advance the early opening sequence until Akademia becomes accessible. Carried-over Archetype growth/equipment can reduce grinding, but follower rank unlock prerequisites must be reestablished where applicable. Do not claim previous endgame follower ranks instantly remain unlocked.

simpleJp: 【任意・2周目】難易度がSTORYTELLERでないことを確認する
enGuide: The New Game+ Redscale Apocalypse Dragon superboss requires Easy or harder; Storyteller mode disables this specific fight. Select a supported difficulty before attempting the achievement. This limitation is independently described by the PowerPyx/PlayStationTrophies superboss guides.

simpleJp: 【任意・2周目】アカデメイアでモアの近くの赤い黙示録を調べる
jpGuide2: アカデメイアにある黙示録を調べると戦えます。
enGuide: Examine the red Book of the Apocalypse next to More in Akademia during NG+ to initiate the Lv99 Redscale Apocalypse Dragon encounter. It is inaccessible in the original first playthrough. Level and gear up first instead of assuming availability means readiness.

simpleJp: 【任意・2周目】『黙示録の赤き竜』に勝利する
enGuide: Defeat Redscale Apocalypse Dragon to obtain the 'Closing the Book' achievement (the only trophy requiring NG+ in major written trophy roadmaps). Bring high-level gear and sustain/buff/debuff skills; reflected/nullifying elements can trigger strong retaliation, so inspect the boss guide if needed. This optional route ends after that NG+ achievement.
